newsitem.title: USA: Saks sees Q1 earnings of about $0.20.
newsitem.headline: Saks sees Q1 earnings of about $0.20.

text.p: Saks Holdings Inc, the holding company for luxury retailer Saks Fifth Avenue, said it estimates lower-than-expected earnings for its first quarter ending May 3 of about $0.20 per share.
Based the projection on sales trends in March and April and that earnings for the quarter will depend on final sales results for April.
It said it currently expects to report sales of about $520 million for the quarter, which compares with $465 million posted for the same quarter itn its fiscal 1996.
It said its first quarter forecast compares with a proforma earnings per share of $0.09 for the first quarter of fiscal 1996.

The quarter's results have primarily been affected by continued softness in its Folio catalog operation, a slowdfown in sales of its Off 5th due to lower than planned sell-off inventory levels, it said.
It also blamed lower than expected sales in casual bridge apparel at its full-line stores.
It expects to report actual quarter results on or about May 15.
